stage_name: Measure the Ceiling and Calibrate Expectations
plain_language_verdict: Even a perfect expected-value predictor is wrong on about 35.0% of papers because citation arrivals follow an over-dispersed Negative Binomial process (phi=3.86). 44.3% of papers have max_k P_ik < 0.60. An 80-85% accuracy on this 3-tier task is mathematically unreachable with 2 years of observed data.
honest_paths_to_80_plus: Selective prediction (abstain on lowest confidence papers)
